orig.credit: African American spiritual (Wallace Willis, after 1865); as quoted in Wikipedia's article
stanzas: Coming for to carry me home.
Coming for to carry me home.
I looked over Jordan, and what did I see,
Coming for to carry me home.
I saw a band of angels coming after me,
Coming for to carry me home.
If you get back to heaven before I do,
Coming for to carry me home.
You'll tell all your friends I'll be coming there too,
Coming for to carry me home.
